definitions.gloss: ordinary person; average person; mediocre person
definitions.explanation: A person of average ability with no outstanding talents. Can be used self-deprecatingly or to contrast with exceptional people.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}はただの{凡人|ぼんじん}です。
{凡人|ぼんじん}には{理解|りかい}できない{世界|せかい}がある。
examples.english: There are worlds that ordinary people cannot understand.

examples.japanese: {天才|てんさい}と{凡人|ぼんじん}の{差|さ}は{努力|どりょく}の{量|りょう}だと{言|い}う{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: Some say the difference between a genius and an ordinary person is the amount of effort.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in a self-deprecating way ({凡人|ぼんじん}ですから) or to highlight the gap between talented people and everyone else. Not inherently negative — it can simply mean someone without special distinction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ただの{凡人|ぼんじん} (just an ordinary person)
- {凡人|ぼんじん}には{無理|むり} (impossible for ordinary people)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {秀才|しゅうさい}: prodigy — the opposite end of the spectrum
- {天才|てんさい}: genius — even further from {凡人|ぼんじん}
- {一般人|いっぱんじん}: ordinary person — more neutral, focuses on being a member of the general public rather than on ability
